name: PlanetScale
subtitle: Managed MySQL (Vitess) and Postgres
creator: Jiten Vaidya and Sugu Sougoumarane (Vitess co-creators)
description: A managed database platform built on Vitess, the sharding system created at YouTube, now offering PostgreSQL too. It is known for branching and deploy requests that apply schema changes without locking tables.
useCases: High-traffic apps that outgrow one database server
Teams that want safe schema changes

codeSamples.label: Shell · PlanetScale CLI
codeSamples.code:
# Create a branch, change the schema safely, then open a deploy request
pscale branch create my-db add-status-column
pscale shell my-db add-status-column
#   > ALTER TABLE orders ADD COLUMN status VARCHAR(20);
pscale deploy-request create my-db add-status-column

cons: Vitess has some MySQL feature limits

pricing.summary: No free tier. Postgres single-node from $5/mo; Vitess (MySQL) production plans from $39/mo.
